name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Direct income support of ₹6000 per year paid in three equal instalments to small and marginal farmer families.
eligibility: Small and marginal landholders, resident Indian citizens.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance to protect farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities, pests and diseases.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Free soil testing and tailored fertilizer recommendations to farmers.

name: PM-KUSUM (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahaabhiyaan)
description: Solarisation of agricultural pumps, decentralised solar power plants and solar water pumps for farmers.
eligibility: Irrigating farmers and C&I entities meeting scheme rules.

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchai Yojana (PMKSY)
description: Accelerated irrigation benefit programme to improve farm productivity through efficient water use and irrigation.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Short-term credit support to farmers for cultivation and other agriculture needs at subsidised interest rates.

name: MIDH (Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture)
description: Support for horticulture development, processing and value addition.

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
description: Promotion of organic farming through cluster-based approaches and support to farmers.

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY)
description: Support state-level agriculture development projects and schemes.
eligibility: State agriculture departments and implementing agencies.

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
description: Online trading portal to connect farmers to markets across India.

name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
description: Increase production of rice, wheat, pulses, and other crops through improved practices.

name: Support for Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs)
description: Financial and technical support for formation and scaling of FPOs.
